title: Thai Crispy Cod Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and crunchy Thai-inspired stir fry dish made with crispy fried cod and peppery vegetables.
instructions: 1. Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced pepper and onion, stir-frying until tender.
3. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
4. Add the cod fillets and stir-fry until golden brown and cooked through.
5. Pour in the stir-fry sauce and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
